decisions.reason: The formwork profile system sits at the core of the firm's formwork know-how and was shown on its own page in both years, so the firm can read its results and keep improving it through its own R&D.

The shuttering magnet block line draws directly on the firm's established magnetic formwork expertise and stayed on the website through 2019, which makes it a low-risk complement to its precast plant offer.
This magnetic formwork component is closely related to existing knowledge and had a dedicated page in both years, which suggests steady commercial relevance.
The component is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the other magnetic products, but it builds on core competence and costs little to keep in the portfolio.
